text: SAFETY (draft S1). Before the public repository exists, no devbin clone on rhadamanth, gyges or kovacs has a remote url or pushurl that resolves to matthewsinclair/devbin, and canon's upstream is removed. Evidence: each sleeve's scan of every git repository under its home at every depth, read back after the change.
